_comment: Flicker catalog (ENGINEERING_CONSTRAINTS.md §10; kinds from Docs/WEIRDNESS_SPEC.md §1, ledger M-1). The six v1 kinds are LOCKED; their min_intensity / weight / cooldown are PROPOSED starting values. The four v1:false kinds exercise the deferred-kind contract and carry conservative placeholder numbers with handler 'log' — they fire nothing until the phase that owns them lands a real handler. No kind may reproduce a scripted beat (§3).

sprite_edge._comment: A figure at the viewport edge for ~6 frames. Gone if the camera moves toward it.

tile_blink._comment: One tile swaps to a wrong-but-plausible neighbour for 2 frames, then restores.

npc_wrong_frame._comment: An idle NPC shows one frame from a different animation, or faces the wrong way, for 1 frame.

sound_offstage._comment: A non-positional one-shot: a bell where there is no bell, a single hammer strike, one chicken.

light_skip._comment: Ambient modulate dips 3% for 1 frame, or a cast shadow with no caster for 3 frames.

npc_line._comment: An NPC's idle bubble (not the dialogue box) shows one line from data/weirdness/lines.json. Never logged, never repeated in-run.

cat_elsewhere._comment: DEFERRED (v1 false). The workshop cat somewhere it cannot be — reserved for the return home. Numbers are conservative placeholders, not spec values.

reflection_lag._comment: DEFERRED (v1 false). Numbers are conservative placeholders, not spec values.

clock_wrong._comment: DEFERRED (v1 false). Numbers are conservative placeholders, not spec values.

double_npc._comment: DEFERRED (v1 false). Numbers are conservative placeholders, not spec values.
